title: Micro Men - 10th Anniversary - With Chris Curry, Steve Furber and Hermann Hauser
summary: The Centre for Computing History reunites Chris Curry, Steve Furber and Hermann Hauser to rewatch the BBC drama Micro Men on its tenth anniversary. They reminisce about Acorn and the early British home computer era.
why: Recommended as a companion to Micro Men, with the real Acorn people commenting on how events actually happened.

quote.text: That drama is even more enjoyable the second time around with commentary from three of the Acorn team portrayed
